trigger.description: The button that opens the keyword filters.

include.description: The placeholder of the input that adds a keyword rows must contain.

exclude.description: The placeholder of the input that adds a keyword rows must not contain.

includeLabel.description: The heading of the section that lists the keywords rows must contain.

excludeLabel.description: The heading of the section that lists the keywords rows must not contain.

match.description: The heading of the control that chooses how the included keywords combine.

and.description: The match mode where a row must contain every included keyword.

or.description: The match mode where a row must contain any included keyword.
